body:
The week before Christmas, my family was just falling apart, and the guy I am, who likes to smoke a lot of weed and do drug experiments, I didnt make the situation better. I feel my life has dramatically changed and I was not lookin forward to Christmas. Well today is Christmas and everything seemed to work out fine. I got 100 bucks so I decided to try somethin new. I already had the coke and weed and lots of it. Then I ran into meth very wierdly. I only bought a 20 of it and it didnt look like much, but my thoughts were way off. The dood I got it off of said he carries some on him at times. Well I did all the coke and then about 2 hours later feeling a bit agitated to be out of coke, the usual shit comedown, I pulled out the ice and started cutting it up. It broke out to about 1/4 the size of a skimpy coke line. Whut the hell why not? I snorted the bump and waited for like 5 min, and I didnt feel anything. I thought it was supposed to be almost instant like coke.
1 hour later feeling a slight head change but nuthin major, I pulled out the gravity and started tokin.. Well just about 5 min later it felt like someone shot novicaine throughout my whole body and my head was spinnin but it all felt good as heck. So throughout the night I got glued to 1 activity, thats chatting online establishing good relationships with close ppl. So in my eyes, I think  I got the best christmas gift, and I hate christmas.
Peace yall hope u learned from my story.
